title: Lists: Ordering, Paging and Contained Types | Orchard Core
description:
A list holds content items of other types, such as a blog and its posts. Editors and visitors need those items on pages of a sensible size, in an order that makes sense, and only of the types the list is meant for.

The settings of the List part on a content type control exactly that: the contained content types, the Page Size, manual ordering by drag and drop, a full pager with numbered pages, and a header with the title of the list.

In this video:
• How the List part settings are organized
• Opening the List settings of a content type
• Choosing the contained content types
• Setting the Page Size and paging through a list
• Ordering the items by dragging them
• The full pager and the container's header
